comparison.objective: Candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs; record assembles a flute and aligns its embouchure hole with the keys.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires recessed tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and fragment pickup; record requires bimanual cylindrical insertion, axial seating, rotational alignment, and gentle placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four valid fractures with retained undamaged inserts and all tangs contained; record requires full tenon insertion, correct angular alignment, keys-up placement on the case lid, and arm retreat.
comparison.reason: The record tests insertion plus rotational registration; the candidate explicitly tests contact-driven fracture and containment, so shared coaxial alignment is only a generic primitive.
